qualification: local A05.4 fault-corpus and interrupt-latency evidence; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

faultRestartabilityMatrix.expectedInvariant: Only the safe instruction prefix retires; the faulting RMW leaves registers, flags, and memory uncommitted and retries at its exact guest RIP.

verification.dbtPCAndRunnerGate: 1,545 tests in 179 suites passed; the environment-driven pinned boot test skipped because its variables were absent, then this runner executed the same pinned inputs explicitly.

latencyInterpretation.pollingContract: The pending byte is polled at every chain-capable block entry, including patched backward targets.
latencyInterpretation.measurement: The one native entry that observed pending work retired zero guest instructions before returning to the dispatcher.
latencyInterpretation.bound: 0 guest instructions for the observed production request; the design-time worst case remains one natural block, capped at 4,096 guest instructions.
latencyInterpretation.clockClaim: No host-time interrupt latency is claimed by this instruction-retirement measurement.

limitations: The production measurement contains one pending-work observation in one run on one local Apple M2 Pro.
Tier-one recovery metadata remains conservatively all-GPR after the unsafe exact-mask attempt was withdrawn.
Baseline inline-TLB page faults still use whole-block rollback and interpreter replay, and callback-bearing raw chain targets remain disabled.
This satisfies the named fault-matrix and bounded interrupt-observation evidence, but does not close the remaining A05.4 precision work or the greater-than-95-percent A05.3 dispatcher gate.
